//instructions: Relative to THIS file's directory, which is dev/ — not the package the docs belong to. The agents/ files are this workspace's AGENTS.md set, all five of them, because a session started in dev/ may work in any package and should not have to know which. The `../principle/` entries are published reference material, not agent instruction, and stay where they ship.
//permission: The workspace's rule, and the reason it lives here rather than in any package: `sed -i*` is denied and the same is true of a Python or heredoc rewrite, but the last of those cannot be expressed as a path pattern. The written rule is in agents/workspace.md and agents/principle.md; this is the part a machine can enforce. `docker compose *` is allowed because nothing here needs rebuilding to see a library change — the app bind-mounts the workspace — and asking about `docker compose` on every command trains people to approve without reading.
